changelog: Record the current webnovel chapter in one narrator voice, then continue later chapters.

en.description: Turn a serialized web novel into chapter-by-chapter webnovel audiobook audio with one consistent narrator. This serialized webnovel audio studio and web novel narration shop records the current chapter first, then continues later chapters in the same voice so listeners can follow a serial novel TTS library as new chapters land. Use it for chapter audiobook production, webnovel chapter audio, serial fiction narration, and ongoing web novel listening.
en.summary: Turn a serialized web novel into chapter-by-chapter webnovel audiobook audio with one consistent narrator.
en.title: Webnovel Serial Audio: Chapter-by-Chapter Listening
